title: VooPoo Vmate Max Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Vmate Max Vape Kit is designed for vapers seeking both power and convenience in a device that oozes luxury and understated elegance. Available in 7 dazzling colours and sporting a faceted gem design, the Voopoo Vmate Max is as aesthetically stunning as it is powerful and functional. Its sleek design includes a hidden horizon screen for settings data such as pod resistance and battery life, and dual 256-colour RGB light bars, completing the device’s stylish and modern look. Equipped with an impressive 1200mAh battery, this device supports up to 30W output, ensuring a consistent, flavoursome and satisfying vape experience, with minimal downtime thanks to fast 5V/2A USB-C charging. Additionally, the Vmate Max features seven safety protections, including overcharge and short-circuit protection, ensuring performance you can rely on. Vaping the Vmate Max is as simple as inhaling on the pod’s mouthpiece. With a simple switch, you can adjust the airflow for your perfect draw as well as choose between three power modes enabled by the GENE.AI Chipset: • SPT: For Full-bodied Flavour • NOR: An Optimal, Balanced Vaping Experience • ECO: Reducing Power and E-liquid Consumption The top-fill 2ml pod system makes refilling straightforward and mess-free, while the ICOSM coil technology enhances flavour and vapour production. The Vmate Max is compatible with the full suite of Vmate pods, including new 0.4Ω and 0.7Ω resistances, catering to both restricted direct lung (RDL) and mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping styles. The included 3X pods have been upgraded to Voopoo’s ICOSM Flavour Code for improved flavour and extended lifespan. They also feature Fresnel lens technology which reduces e-liquid deterioration by reducing light glare. The skid-proof design and secure snap-in cartridges further enhance user convenience, making this kit an excellent choice for both novice and experienced vapers on the go. We recommend paring these pods with 50% VG E-Liquid. Vmate Top Fill 0.4ohm RDTL use Nic Salt or 50/50 E-Liquid Vmate Top Fill 0.7ohm MTL use Nic Salt or 50/50 E-Liquid Browse our vape juice and find the perfect flavour to match this kit Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
